label: Cyberpunk Street
description: Street level in the rain-lit city: signage as the light source, crowd as texture, and the camera down where the puddles are. Defaults to the street itself — the section also holds hangars and plant halls, which are a different picture.
prefix: A street-level cyberpunk scene, the city lit almost entirely by its own signage
suffix: shot from street level: wet asphalt returning every sign as a coloured smear, layered depth of signage and steam, one figure anchoring the scale, practical light only
negative: clean dry street, daylight, empty sterile plaza, watermark, signature, text artifacts, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, child, underage, nsfw
